name: dt_street_concept
subject: make this old town street lovely and finished like Gamla stan in Stockholm. The thin grey lines become a real vintage tram stop shelter: dark green painted iron posts, a glass roof with a decorative iron frieze, a wooden bench, the round tram sign on its post. The house fronts get moulded cornices, window surrounds, a shop front with a striped awning and a hanging iron shop sign with a picture (no letters), flower boxes, iron wall anchors. The ice cream freezer and the crates stay as they are. Nothing floats: the two dark ledges at the top attach to the wall with stone corbels

slot.where: Downtown tall street, camera y 240 x 1920, the tram stop

extra: Bright warm afternoon colours, full local colour and crisp edges, the same flat-shaded pixel style as the dog. Keep the dog, the crates, the goose and the framing exactly as they are.
